title: UK football stadiums — city collection style
stadium_geometry_policy: All supplied native shell and detail paths retained in geographic registration. Native cubic controls are preserved.

stadiums.name: Emirates Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the elliptical body, rectangular rounded opening and four principal truss runs. Opposed roof clearances and overall pitch/body proportions compare well; elevated roof displacement is not a reason to move the pitch.

stadiums.name: Villa Park
stadiums.review_note: Preserved the four unequal stands, deep chamfered Trinity roof and Holte end. Regularised the tiny gap beside the north-corner building into a shared junction, avoiding two edges merging at A3 pen weight. This is a small cartographic simplification, not a measured relocation of the building. The road hidden under Trinity Stand is suppressed only beneath the roof.

stadiums.name: Etihad Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Corrected the northern/top roof edge: the crown is now on the pitch's long centreline, removing the previous 6.5 m model offset. Two broad native curves give the north shoulders an even sweep, with matching tangent and curvature at the crown instead of the former pinched bend. Roof bays meet the revised boundary. The pitch, southern expanded end, main roof band and eight occluded access-tower caps are retained. Google shows an earlier North Stand phase; this drawing does not certify the completed 2026 extension.

stadiums.name: Old Trafford
stadiums.review_note: Retained the broad Ferguson roof, shallower Charlton side and smoothly joined end quadrants. The prior doubled truss edges remain removed; roof levels are connected contours, not square construction boxes.

stadiums.name: St James' Park
stadiums.review_note: Retained the unequal L-shaped high Milburn/Leazes roof and lower opposite stands. The high/low junctions fit the reference; no square corner guide boxes or duplicate outer shell were reintroduced.

stadiums.name: Stadium of Light
stadiums.review_note: Retained the approved benchmark geometry: joined curved corners, larger stepped west/north-side footprint and centred opening. Main roof levels agree with the overhead; no extra outline or cross-bracing added.

stadiums.name: Stamford Bridge
stadiums.review_note: Separated the straight rear edge of the West Stand canopy from the curved lower building behind it. Roof bay lines now stop at the actual canopy edge instead of treating the whole rear footprint as one deep roof. Other three unequal roofs and the curved principal bands are retained.

stadiums.name: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Expanded the overly tight roof opening from approximately 117 by 81 m to 134 by 88 m, without enlarging the pitch. Retained the asymmetric flowing shell and a single consistent translucent band. The Google field is event-covered, so the retained football datum is used, not the event floor perimeter.

stadiums.name: Craven Cottage
stadiums.review_note: Replaced the generic Riverside stripe with a reduced stepped terrace/glass-roof boundary. Retained the distinct end stands, Johnny Haynes roof and Cottage pavilion. Google shows Riverside construction; the completed-roof layout is cross-checked against the cached Esri overhead rather than regressed to a construction gap.

stadiums.name: Selhurst Park
stadiums.review_note: Retained the four separate rectilinear roofs, stepped Holmesdale end and Main Stand pavilion. Opening and stand proportions compare well. This is the visible reference-era Main Stand, not a proposed replacement.

stadiums.name: Gtech Community Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Restored both chamfered upper corners and the angular southern site outline. Repositioned the solar-bank outline as one tapering group and removed its invented internal divider. Omitted the generic inner offset stripe that merged with the solar-bank edge at A3 pen weight. Principal hips connect the real roof corners; the pitch stays at its original scale.

stadiums.name: Anfield
stadiums.review_note: Retained the deep Main Stand, asymmetric completed Anfield Road extension, Kop and shallower Dalglish roof. Google shows an earlier Anfield Road phase; the completed extension is corroborated by the cached Esri overhead and retained project references.

stadiums.name: Elland Road
stadiums.review_note: Restored the missing curved northwest roof quadrant beside the Don Revie/East Stand junction. The new native curve joins the deep East Stand, rather than stopping in an implausibly small corner. Regularised two tiny opposite stand junctions and the rear annexe to share edges at plot scale: sub-pen-width gaps are deliberately omitted, not claimed absent in the real building. The unequal main stand depths remain.

stadiums.name: The City Ground
stadiums.review_note: Replaced the stepped Brian Clough rear outline with the continuous rectangular canopy visible in both overheads. The neighbouring service buildings are no longer mistaken for a roof extension. Retained the separate Trent End, curved Bridgford and shallower Taylor roof.

stadiums.name: Hill Dickinson Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the completed Hill Dickinson shell, bowed long-side edges and rectangular end roofs. Google shows construction and cannot date the finished roof; the completed Esri overhead and club stadium/pitch references corroborate the retained edition. Pitch dimensions are not inferred from the construction apron.

stadiums.name: Vitality Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Preserved the compact four separate canopies and open stadium corners. Joined the rear main-stand annexe on one shared edge instead of retaining a two-metre slit that printed as a doubled dark stripe. This is a plot-scale simplification of the building junction; overall stand depths, pitch position and dimensions are unchanged.

stadiums.name: American Express Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the smooth asymmetric Amex outline and two bowed principal truss runs, checked against both overheads. The main roof remains one outline; the genuine truss chords are not additional stadium shells. Did not shrink the roof from a displaced Google edge alone.

stadiums.name: Coventry Building Society Arena
stadiums.review_note: Retained the joined arena/exhibition-hall outline and restrained major roof seams. The hall is a distinct adjoining building, not another outline around the bowl. The previously removed duplicate contour remains absent.

stadiums.name: MKM Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the cleaned MKM shell and bowed main-stand geometry. Google and Esri displace the high roof differently; the Esri and pinned ground footprint support the existing depth. No repeated perimeter tracing was added to chase the photographic displacement.

stadiums.name: Portman Road
stadiums.review_note: Retained four unequal roof blocks and characteristic end-stand steps. The 105 by 68 m field is the playing surface, not the larger grass apron. Main stand depths and opening agree with the comparison.

stadiums.name: St Andrew's @ Knighthead Park
stadiums.review_note: Retained the separate Main and Gil Merrick stands and smoothly connected Kop/Tilton corner. The overhead displaces the roofs in a common direction; the pitch remains centred on the stand-front datum, not the photographic roof centroid.

stadiums.name: Ewood Park
stadiums.review_note: Retained four unequal Ewood Park roofs and the three principal support frames. Stand widths and the shallower Riverside side compare well; genuine truss chords remain, duplicate stand-edge lengths do not.

stadiums.name: Toughsheet Community Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Replaced the exaggerated bowed parallel truss ribbons with a restrained four-sided principal support frame connected to the four corner masts. The two overheads show different elevation/parallax separation of the truss chords, so the drawing uses reduced plan axes, not their shadows or elevation bows. Oval canopy and pitch scale are retained.

stadiums.name: Ashton Gate Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Reduced the overly deep Dolman and Lansdown roofs, rejoined the curved South Stand corner to the corrected rear edge, and resized the single solar-bank group. Preserved the exact shared curved stand front, separate Atyeo roof and centred playing field.

stadiums.name: Turf Moor
stadiums.review_note: Retained Turf Moor's four unequal canopies, principal trusses and small accessible corner roofs. Common photographic roof displacement is not copied into the pitch datum; the large northern forecourt remains excluded from the stadium roof.

stadiums.name: Cardiff City Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the rounded main ring and distinctly deeper Ninian extension. The upper-tier block is a real extension, not a second outline. Opening proportions and shared roof boundaries compare well.

stadiums.name: The Valley
stadiums.review_note: Retained the three connected Valley stands and separate Jimmy Seed roof. Rounded corners reuse the same front curves, avoiding double lips. Long-side roof bays remain parallel.

stadiums.name: Pride Park Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained Pride Park's rounded rectangular body, appropriately scaled opening and reduced principal support lines. Main geometry agrees with the overhead and does not need extra perimeter tracing.

stadiums.name: LNER Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the distinctive short split Sincil Bank roofs, deeper Co-op stand and small end roofs. The gaps and unequal lengths are real features, not unfinished linework.

stadiums.name: Riverside Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained Riverside's smooth joined outer roof and centred rectangular opening. The main roof/body proportions compare closely with the Google view; only the existing restrained roof divisions are kept.

stadiums.name: The Den
stadiums.review_note: Retained the Den's four separate canopies and main longitudinal support frames. Open corners remain open; adding a continuous generic bowl roof would misrepresent this ground.

stadiums.name: Carrow Road
stadiums.review_note: Retained the unequal River End/Barclay roofs, rounded main-side junction and angular corner hotel. The hotel is not used to centre or scale the pitch. Main roof depths compare adequately allowing for parallax.

stadiums.name: Fratton Park
stadiums.review_note: Removed the historic triangular South Stand roof gable/ridge from this edition: the Google reference shows the later continuous blue roof. The older Esri image visibly has the gable, so this is an imagery-era difference, not a claim the old feature was imaginary. Four separate roofs and the sloped North Stand folds remain.

stadiums.name: Deepdale
stadiums.review_note: Retained four separate roofs, the rectangular principal truss frame and four corner pylons. The source supports these paired structural lines; earlier shared-edge cleanup is preserved.

stadiums.name: MATRADE Loftus Road Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the very tight four-sided Loftus Road footprint, sloping end roof and rear service block. The pitch/opening proportions are intentionally compact and compare with the overhead.

stadiums.name: Bramall Lane
stadiums.review_note: Retained the unequal Bramall Lane roofs and smoothly connected John Street/Kop corner. The front curve is shared once; the corrected corner seam does not cross an extra square guide line.

stadiums.name: St Mary's Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained St Mary's continuous rounded roof and principal seams. The apparent extra north-side block is a real service building visible in the second overhead, so it has not been incorrectly deleted.

stadiums.name: bet365 Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the three-sided curved horseshoe, separate bowed West Stand and infill corner. Main stand depths and the open southwest junction remain distinct; no second offset stadium outline added.

stadiums.name: Swansea.com Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained the approved benchmark: a clean rounded ring, consistent inner band, deeper rear stand strip and centred pitch. Parallel bays and native curves compare well with the actual roof.

stadiums.name: Vicarage Road
stadiums.review_note: Retained eleven connected Graham Taylor barrel-roof modules, four unequal stands and the rounded corner pavilion. Each module separator is drawn once; narrow repeated outlines remain removed.

stadiums.name: The Hawthorns
stadiums.review_note: Retained the curved connected Hawthorns stands, separate Smethwick end and characteristic deep angular East Stand annexe. Its roof folds terminate on actual roof boundaries and are not extra perimeter shells.

stadiums.name: London Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Widened the London Stadium translucent-roof boundary, removed the unsupported extra surface ellipse and eleven invented solar-zone blocks, and replaced the centre-star cable pattern with parallel long-side runs and fanned ends. This matches the captured pre-solar overhead. The stadium operator confirms solar membrane installation in 2025; this reference-era drawing does not claim to map that later installation.

stadiums.name: Molineux Stadium
stadiums.review_note: Retained Molineux's four unequal curved/trapezoidal roofs, broad Stan Cullis end and small corner pavilion. Actual stand asymmetry is preserved without moving the pitch off the paired stand-front centre.

stadiums.name: STōK Cae Ras
stadiums.review_note: Removed the historic Kop terrace outline and its three level lines because the Google overhead shows a cleared end. Retained the three visible roofs and Mold Road scallop. The pitch-side boundary at the open end is a bowl datum, not a roof or a claim that the new Kop is complete.
